PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Service & Support The Service Provider is required to have at least 20 % of the required manpower on service provider’s payroll for at least one year. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) 1.The bidder must note that only 02 numbers of MTS to be employed and each day work to be assigned. 2.The payment of salary is the responsibility of the service provider, and it should be done every month an d confirmed to the Head of this Institute before 15 th day of every month. 3. The employes should not be changed frequently, and same person should be continued until unless th e Head of Institute warranted to do so. 4. In case of MTS is on leave or absent another MTS should be provided for that particular day. 5. The verification of character of MTS being employed is the responsibility of service provider. 6, No person below 18 years of age should be employed. 7. Service provider must provide needed consumables to employees. 8. Working hours of the MTS will be in two sessions ie: in the morning and afternoon sessions. 9. Welfare of the MTS is the sole responsibility of be the service provider. 10. A supervisor of the service provider should visit this Institute every month and make sure work carried
out by MTS is proper and satisfactory. 11. Payment of the contract amount on monthly basis will be done after verification of bill, ESI & EPF recei pt.
